newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Chirac condemns shootings on Israel-Jordan border.
newsitem.headline: Chirac condemns shootings on Israel-Jordan border.

text.p: French President Jacques Chirac condemned Thursday's killing of seven Israeli schoolgirls on the Israeli-Jordanian border, saying he learned of the incident with horror.

"I learned with horror of this abominable attack...and wish to share with you my indignation and sadness," Chirac aides quoted him as messaging Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu from Brazil where the French leader is on an official visit.
A lone Jordanian soldier shot dead seven Israeli schoolgirls and wounded six while the children were on a field trip to the border between Israel and Jordan.
